title: Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yoma 78a Rabbah bar bar Chana said: “They asked Rabbi Elazar (ben Pedat)… Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka stood on his feet and said: I saw Rabbi Yose ben Zimra, who was old and sat in the academy,” etc.

Hyman infers from this that he belonged to the generation after Rabbi, for Rabbi Yose ben Zimra was related by marriage to Rabbi. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chaluka, and Hyman likewise notes that Yuchasin did not cite Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka.

notes.text: Saved Davidson Yoma 78a writes Chakula, against the supplied Chaluka and Hyman’s reported Dikdukei Soferim Yitzchak reading. Likewise is additive, not a claim that Yuchasin’s omission was caused by that variant. Related by marriage does not specify which children married.
